scope: Clean minimal Ubuntu rootfs bootstrap, cross-host source archive reproducibility, first-boot release staging, explicit activation, stop, and container restart. This is not a full bare-metal VM reinstall or power-loss qualification.

source_acquisition.method: fresh single-branch clone through the VPS read-only GitHub deploy-key SSH alias

normalization.regular_file_modes: 0644, or 0755 when any executable bit is present

clean_rootfs.creation: debootstrap noble with main and universe components; no project state or credentials
clean_rootfs.setup: Deleted the generated .venv in the isolated checkout, then make setup completed without user input using the checked-in development lock and editable project install.
clean_rootfs.first_setup_failure: The initial minimal package set had python3.12 but lacked the unversioned python3 executable expected by Makefile setup; installing Ubuntu's python3 package closed the gap.

deployment.execution_environment: systemd-nspawn booted minimal rootfs on the disposable Ubuntu VPS; nspawn was granted CAP_SYS_ADMIN and CAP_NET_ADMIN for the isolated service network-namespace check

limits: The clean image was an isolated debootstrap rootfs using the VPS host kernel, not a separate bare-metal VM reinstall.

The initial nspawn capability set could not create the release unit's PrivateNetwork namespace; after granting only CAP_SYS_ADMIN and CAP_NET_ADMIN to the disposable nspawn container, activation used a distinct network namespace. The actual VPS release qualification independently observed a private namespace without nested-container restrictions.
Package installation is still a manually assembled package closure; an unattended supported-host provisioner and pinned repository snapshot are not implemented.
No ARM64, Windows/WSL, CUDA/NVIDIA, power-loss, production data, provider credentials, or Migration v1 behavior is qualified.
next_horizon: Design and qualify an unattended Ubuntu host capability/package preflight and provisioning contract, keeping apt package resolution separate from release identity and failing before mutation when host prerequisites are missing.
